spanish: Y toda ofrenda que se horneare en el horno, y todo lo hecho en la sartén y sobre la plancha, al sacerdote el acercante a ella, a él será.
grammarChanges: minjá → ofrenda (H4503 is a common noun; render as a Spanish common noun, per auditor fail on h03007009002)
se cocinare → se horneare (Niphal imperfect of H644 is specifically be baked, not generic cooking, per auditor fail on h03007009004)
toda hecha → todo lo hecho (H6213 נַעֲשָׂה here is a masculine substantival niphal perfect, not feminine agreement with the offering, per auditor warn on h03007009006/h03007009007)
sobre plancha → sobre la plancha (supplied article required for Spanish grammaticality; matches the feminine noun already articled as 'la sartén')
readerNote: Chose the masculine substantival 'todo lo hecho' over feminine agreement with the offering, since the niphal perfect in that clause is grammatically masculine and not keyed to minjá's gender.
